newsitem.title: USA: Amcor to buy California waste business.
newsitem.headline: Amcor to buy California waste business.

text.p: Amcor Capital Corp said Tuesday it will buy part of privately-held waste company TransPacific Environmental Inc for a combination of cash and stock.

Amcor will take over TransPacific's green waste recycling division by June 30, the company said. A spokesman said the acquisition is expected to generate revenues of more than $8 million for fiscal 1998, which starts September 1.
"We're estimating (net earnings) of $0.50 per share for fiscal 1998, as opposed to $0.37 for this (fiscal) year," the spokesman said.
